
=== WebPanel: Produccion.ExclusionDelDia ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&Fecha = Today()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the grid
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoGenerar' (Event) ---
&Turno.Load(&TurnoId)
	&ExtrusionFecha = &Fecha
	&ExtrusionFecha = &ExtrusionFecha.AddHours(&Turno.TurnoHoraInicio.Hour())
	
	
	&SDTExtrusion = ExtrusionDelDiaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionFecha, &ExtrusoraId, &TurnoId, &ProductoId)
	if(&SDTExtrusion.Count = 0)
		&newExtrusionId = CrearExtrusion.Udp(&TurnoId,&ExtrusoraId,&ExtrusionFecha,&ProductoId,&OperadorId)
		if(&newExtrusionId>0)
			&SDTExtrusion = ExtrusionDelDiaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionFecha, &ExtrusoraId, &TurnoId, &ProductoId)
		endif
	endif
	Grid1.Refresh()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Enter (Event) ---
if(&SDTExtrusion.Count > 0)
		
		&SDTExtrusionItem = &SDTExtrusion.Item(1)
		&ExtrusionId = &SDTExtrusionItem.ExtrusionId
		if(GuardarExtrusion.Udp(&SDTExtrusionItem))
		        Produccion.ExtrusionDelDiaBobinas.Call(&ExtrusionId)
		endif
	else
		msg('No existe la extrusión en sistema')
	endif

=== Procedure: Produccion.CrearExtrusion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&ExtrusionCalibre.SetEmpty()
&ExtrusionAncho.SetEmpty()
&ExtrusionLongitud.SetEmpty()

do 'CalibrarExtrusion'

&Extrusion = New()
&Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId 
&Extrusion.ExtrusionTurnoId = &TurnoId

&Extrusion.ExtrusionFecha = &ExtrusionFecha
&Extrusion.ExtrusionProductoId = &ProductoId
if(&OperadorId>0)
	&Extrusion.ExtrusionOperadorId = &OperadorId
else
	&Extrusion.ExtrusionOperadorId.SetNull()
endif

&Extrusion.ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.PorProgramar
&Extrusion.ExtrusionSiloId.SetNull()
&Extrusion.ExtrusionSiloMolidoId.SetNull()

&Extrusion.ExtrusionCalibre = &ExtrusionCalibre
&Extrusion.ExtrusionAncho = &ExtrusionAncho
&Extrusion.ExtrusionLongitud = &ExtrusionLongitud

&Extrusion.Save()
if(&Extrusion.Success())
	commit
	&ExtrusionId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionId
Else
	debugger.Call(niveldebug.Informativo, &Pgmname, &Extrusion.ToJson())
	setnotSuccessMessagesLog.Call(&Extrusion.GetMessages(), &Pgmname)
	&ExtrusionId = 0
endif


Sub 'CalibrarExtrusion'
	for each DB.ExtrusoraProducto
		where ExtrusoraProductoId > 0
		where ExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
		where ProductoId = &ProductoId
		
		&ExtrusionCalibre = ExtrusoraProductoCalibre
                &ExtrusionAncho = ExtrusoraProductoAncho
                &ExtrusionLongitud = ExtrusoraProductoLongitud
		Exit
	endfor
EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&TurnoId, in:&ExtrusoraId, in:&ExtrusionFecha,in:&ProductoId,in:&OperadorId,out:&ExtrusionId);


=== WebPanel: Produccion.ExtrusionDelDiaBobinas ===

--- Start (Event) ---
&Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
	&ExtrusoraId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId
	&ExtrusionEstado = &Extrusion.ExtrusionEstado
	&SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId,&Empty,&ValueZero)
	do 'SetActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid1_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid1.InternalName
	Grid1.Rows = Page.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid1.Load (Event) ---
&BobinaEstado = &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaEstado
	Do Case
		Case &BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion
                     do 'EnableFields'
		Otherwise
		     do 'DisableFields'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	//this code should be inside the For Each used to load the grid
	Do Case
		Case &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso
			&Grid1Badge = "En Proceso"
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = "En Proceso"
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !' AttributeTagWarning BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion
			&Grid1Badge = "En Medición"
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = "En Medición"
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !' AttributeTagInfo BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Reposo
			&Grid1Badge = "Reposo"
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = "Reposo"
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !' AttributeTagSuccess BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Case &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Molino
			&Grid1Badge = "Molino"
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = "Molino"
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !' AttributeTagDanger BootstrapTooltipRight'
		Otherwise
			&Grid1Badge = ''
			&Grid1Badge.TooltipText = ''
			&Grid1Badge.Class = !''
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoAgregarBobinas' (Event) ---
&isOK = BobinasEnMedicion.Udp(&SDTBobina)
	if(&isOK)
		MedirBobinasEnProceso.Call(&SDTBobina)
		IniciarBobinas.Call(&ExtrusionId)
		&SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId,&Empty,&ValueZero)
	endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoMedirBobinas' (Event) ---
MedirBobinasEnProceso.Call(&SDTBobina)
	&SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId,&Empty,&ValueZero)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoValidarMedicion' (Event) ---
ValidarMedicion.Call(&SDTBobina)
	&SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId,&Empty,&ValueZero)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoIniciarExtrusion' (Event) ---
IniciarBobinas.Call(&ExtrusionId)
         SetEstadoExtrusion.Call(&ExtrusionId, EstadoExtrusion.EnProceso)
	 &SDTBobina = BobinaDP.Udp(&ExtrusionId,&Empty,&ValueZero)
	 &ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.EnProceso
	 do 'SetActions'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoDetenerExtrusora' (Event) ---
ExtrusoraDetenida.Popup(&ExtrusionId)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoFinalizarExtrusion' (Event) ---
&isOK = FinalizarExtrusion.Udp(&ExtrusionId, &SDTBobina)
	if(&isOK)
	        SetEstadoExtrusion.Call(&ExtrusionId, EstadoExtrusion.Terminada)
		do 'SetActions'
	endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- SDTBobina__BobinaKg.ControlValueChanged() (Event) ---
if(&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaKg > 0)
		&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMermaKg = 0
		&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica
		SDTBobina__BobinaMotivoMolino.Enabled = false
	endif

--- SDTBobina__BobinaMermaKg.ControlValueChanged() (Event) ---
if(&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMermaKg > 0)
		&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaKg = 0
		&SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica
		SDTBobina__BobinaMotivoMolino.Enabled = true
	endif

--- SDTBobina__BobinaMotivoMolino.ControlValueChanged (Event) ---
&MotivoMolino = &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMotivoMolino
	Do Case
	       	/*Case &MotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.LimpiezaContaminacion
		     SDTBobina__BobinaObservaciones.SetFocus()
		Case &MotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.FallaMecanica
		      SDTBobina__BobinaObservaciones.SetFocus()*/
	        Case &MotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica
		      &SDTBobina.CurrentItem.BobinaMermaKg = 0
		      SDTBobina__BobinaKg.SetFocus()
        EndCase

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ExtrusionId);

=== Procedure: Produccion.GuardarExtrusion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

&Extrusion.Load(&SDTExtrusionItem.ExtrusionId)
&Extrusion.FromJson(&SDTExtrusionItem.ToJson())
&Extrusion.Save()
&Correcto = &Extrusion.Success()

if(&Correcto)
	commit
else
	msg('Extrusion guardado: ' + &Extrusion.GetMessages().ToJson())
endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SDTExtrusionItem,out:&Correcto);

=== DataProvider: Produccion.TipoBobinasDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTProducto
{
	SDTProductoItem
	where DB.ExtrusoraProductoId > 0
	Where ExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
	where ProductoId > 0
	where ProductoActivo = true
	where ProductoCategoriaNombre = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'CategoriaBobina')
	{
		ProductoId = ProductoId
		ProductoClave = ProductoClave
		ProductoNombre = ProductoNombre
		ProductoDescripcion = ProductoDescripcion
		ProductoCategoriaId = ProductoCategoriaId
		ProductoCategoriaNombre = ProductoCategoriaNombre
		ProductoPrecioUnitario = ProductoPrecioUnitario
		ProductoInventarioActual = ProductoInventarioActual
		ProductoActivo = ProductoActivo
		ProductoClaveExterna = ProductoClaveExterna
		ProductoImagen = ProductoImagen
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(&ExtrusoraId);

=== Transaction: DB.ExtrusoraProducto ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_ExtrusoraId.SetEmpty()
	&Insert_ProductoId.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated ExtrusoraId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ExtrusoraId"
					&Insert_ExtrusoraId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
				// When inserting with instantiated ProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"ProductoId"
					&Insert_ProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	If &Mode = TrnMode.Delete
		btn_Enter.Caption = "GX_BtnDelete"
		btn_Enter.TooltipText = "GX_BtnDelete"
	EndIf
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWExtrusoraProducto()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&ExtrusoraProductoId);

ExtrusoraProductoId = &ExtrusoraProductoId if not &ExtrusoraProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraProductoId);
noprompt(ExtrusoraProductoId);

ExtrusoraId = &Insert_ExtrusoraId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ExtrusoraId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ExtrusoraId.IsEmpty();
ProductoId = &Insert_ProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(ProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_ProductoId.IsEmpty();}
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */


=== DataProvider: Produccion.BobinaDP ===

--- Source (Source) ---
SDTBobina
{
	SDTBobinaItem
	where ExtrusionId = &ExtrusionId when &ExtrusionId > 0
	where BobinaEstado = &BobinaEstado when Not &BobinaEstado.IsEmpty()
	where BobinaProductoId = &ProductoId when &ProductoId > 0
	{
		BobinaId = BobinaId
		ExtrusionId = ExtrusionId
		BobinaOrigen = BobinaOrigen
		BobinaHoraInicio = BobinaHoraInicio
		HoraInicio = BobinaHoraInicio
		BobinaHoraSalida = BobinaHoraSalida
		HoraSalida = BobinaHoraSalida
		BobinaNo = BobinaNo
		BobinaDesviacionEstandar = BobinaDesviacionEstandar
		BobinaColorEstacion = BobinaColorEstacion
		BobinaKg = BobinaKg
		BobinaKgTexto = trim(BobinaKg.ToString())
		BobinaMermaKg = BobinaMermaKg
		BobinaMermaKgTexto = trim(BobinaMermaKg.ToString())
		BobinaEspesor = BobinaEspesor
		BobinaObservaciones = BobinaObservaciones
		BobinaNoSerie = BobinaNoSerie
		BobinaEstado = BobinaEstado
		BobinaMotivoMolino = BobinaMotivoMolino
		MotivoObservaciones = iif(BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica,'',BobinaMotivoMolino) + ' ' + BobinaObservaciones
		BobinaProductoId = BobinaProductoId
		BobinaProductoNombre = BobinaProductoNombre
		BobinaCarreras = BobinaCarreras
		BobinaIniciaReposo = BobinaIniciaReposo
		BobinaMinutosEnReposo = BobinaMinutosEnReposo
		BobinaEtiqueta = '<b>' + BobinaNo.ToFormattedString() + BobinaOrigen.Trim() + '</b>'
	}
}

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId, in:&BobinaEstado, in:&ProductoId);


=== Procedure: Produccion.BobinasEnMedicion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	&isOK = true
	
	//Cambiar estado de las bobinas En Proceso -: En Medición
	For &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobina
		
	      if(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion)
		      &isOK = false
		      Exit
	      endif
	Endfor

        if(Not &isOK)
		msg('Debe validar las bobinas que estan medición')
        endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SDTBobina, out:&isOK);


=== WebPanel: Produccion.ExtrusoraDetenida ===

--- &Detenido.ControlValueChanged (Event) ---
if(Not &Detenido)
		tb1.Visible = true
	else
		tb1.Visible = false
	endif

--- Start (Event) ---
&Detenido = true
	tb1.Visible = false
	tb2.Visible = false
	Retomar.Enabled = false

--- 'Aceptar' (Event) ---
if(Not &Detenido) //Interrupcion
		if(Not &Motivo.IsEmpty())
	              Aceptar.Enabled = false
		      Retomar.Enabled = true
		      &Motivo.Enabled = false
		      &Detenido.Enabled = false
		      tb2.Visible = true
		      
		      &Id = CrearInterrupcion.Udp(&Motivo)
		      do 'ExtrusionInterrupcion' 
	       else
		       msg('Debe redactar el motivo de la interrupción')
	       endif
		     
	else
	     return
	endif

--- 'Retomar' (Event) ---
&Temporizador.Stop()
	
	//Actualizar hora
	&Interrupcion.Load(&Id)
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionHoraFin = Now()
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionTiempo = &Temporizador
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionConcluida = true
	&Interrupcion.Save()
	
	if(&Interrupcion.Success())
		commit
		return
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId);


=== Procedure: Produccion.FinalizarExtrusion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	&isOK = true
	&EnMedicion = 0
	&EnProceso = 0
	&SDTBobinaPendiente.Clear()
	
        For &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobina
		
		&BobinaEstado = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado
		Do Case
			
			Case &BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion
				&EnMedicion += 1
				
			Case &BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso
			        &EnProceso += 1
				&SDTBobinaPendiente.Add(&SDTBobinaItem)
		EndCase
        	
	Endfor

        if(&EnMedicion = 0)
		if(&EnProceso > 0)
			&ExtId = SgteTurnoExtrusora.Udp(&ExtrusionId)
			
			if(&ExtId > 0)
				ReasignarBobinaTurno.Call(&ExtId, &SDTBobinaPendiente)
				SetEstadoExtrusion.Call(&ExtId, Produccion.EstadoExtrusion.EnProceso)
			else
				&isOK = false
				msg('No se ha podido encontrar el sgte turno')
			endif	
		endif
        else
		&isOK = false
		msg('Debe validar las bobinas que se encuentran En Medición')
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId, in:&SDTBobina, out:&isOK);


=== Procedure: Produccion.IniciarBobinas ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	&Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
	&SiloVirgenId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionSiloId
	&LoteVirgen = &Extrusion.ExtrusionLoteSilo
	&SiloMolidoId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionSiloMolidoId
	&ProductoId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionProductoId
	&ExtrusoraId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId
	
	&BobinaNo = Produccion.GenerarBobinaNo.Udp(&ExtrusoraId, &ProductoId)
	&BobinaNo += 1
	
	//Estacion A
	&SDTBobinaItem = new()
	&SDTBobinaItem.ExtrusionId = &ExtrusionId
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaNo = &BobinaNo
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraInicio = Now()
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraSalida = Now()
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen = OrigenBobina.A
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloVirgenId = &SiloVirgenId
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaLoteVirgen = &LoteVirgen
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloMolidoId = &SiloMolidoId
	
	GuardarBobina.Call(&SDTBobinaItem)
	
	//Estacion B
	&SDTBobinaItem = new()
	&SDTBobinaItem.ExtrusionId = &ExtrusionId
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaNo = &BobinaNo
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraInicio = Now()
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraSalida = Now()
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen = OrigenBobina.B
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloVirgenId = &SiloVirgenId
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaLoteVirgen = &LoteVirgen
	&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloMolidoId = &SiloMolidoId
	
	GuardarBobina.Call(&SDTBobinaItem)

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId);


=== Procedure: Produccion.MedirBobinasEnProceso ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	//Cambiar estado de las bobinas En Proceso -: En Medición
	For &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobina
		
	      if(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnProceso)
		      &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion
		      &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraSalida = Now()
		      GuardarBobina.Call(&SDTBobinaItem)
	      endif
      
	Endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SDTBobina);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ObtenerConfiguracion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
FOR EACH DB.Configuracion
	WHERE ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
	&ConfiguracionValor = ConfiguracionValor
	EXIT
WHEN NONE
	new 
		ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		ConfiguracionValor = ''
	endnew
	commit
ENDFOR

--- Rules (Rules) ---
PARM(IN:&ConfiguracionKey, OUT:&ConfiguracionValor);

=== Procedure: Produccion.SetEstadoExtrusion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
         
	 &Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
	 &Extrusion.ExtrusionEstado = &ExtrusionEstado
	 
	 Do Case
		 Case &ExtrusionEstado = Produccion.EstadoExtrusion.EnProceso
		         &Extrusion.ExtrusionHoraIniciaProceso = Now()
		 Case &ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Terminada
		         &Extrusion.ExtrusionHoraFinProceso = Now()
	 EndCase
	 
	 &Extrusion.Save()
	 
	 if(&Extrusion.Success())
		 commit
         endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId, in:&ExtrusionEstado);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ValidarMedicion ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	For &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobina	
		if(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.EnMedicion)
			&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Molino
			
			if(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica)
				&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado = EstadoBobina.Reposo
				//&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaIniciaReposo = Now()
			endif
			
		        GuardarBobina.Call(&SDTBobinaItem)
		endif	
	Endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SDTBobina);


=== Procedure: Web.Debugger ===

--- Source (Source) ---
/*
 Niveles de debug:
0 - Apagado
1 - Informativo
2 - Advertencia
3 - Debug
4 - Error
5 - Critico
El Nivel de debug detallará a partir de que nivel se desea informar:
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 0(Apagado) -> no se generan logs
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 1(Critico) -> se muestran solo los críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 2(Error) -> se muestran los de tipo error y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 3(Degub) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 3(Advertencia) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub, advertencia y críticos
	Si por ejemplo el parámetro indica 5(Informativo) -> se muestran los de tipo error, degub, advertencia, informativos y críticos
	
*/

//call("CargarContexto", &Contexto)
&Usuario = &WebSession.Get('UserName').ToString()


&HTTP_HOST= &HttpRequest.BaseUrl.Replace('/','')
&HTTP_HOST= &HTTP_HOST.Replace(':','')
&FechaArchivo = Now()
//Se carga el nivel del debug configurado en base de datos
&NivelDebugConfigurado = NivelDebug.Informativo
//Se carga el tipo de debugg base de datos o archivo
&TipoDebug = TipoDebug.Archivo
&NivelDebugDescripcion = &NivelDebug.EnumerationDescription()

//valida si el debug esta prendido o esta dentro del rango
if &NivelDebugConfigurado  >= &NivelDebug
	do case
		case &TipoDebug = TipoDebug.BaseDatos
			//guardar en base de datos
		case &TipoDebug = TipoDebug.Archivo
			//guardad en archivo
			Do 'GuardarArchivo'
	endcase
else
	return
endif


sub 'GuardarArchivo'
	&NombreArchivo =  &HTTP_HOST.Trim() + "_" + &FechaArchivo.Year().ToString().Trim()+&FechaArchivo.Month().ToString().Trim()+&FechaArchivo.Day().ToString().Trim() + ".log"
	
	&MensajeDebug =  "-> Usuario: "+ &Usuario.ToString() +" | "+&Time.ToString().Trim()+" ("+&NivelDebugDescripcion.Trim()+") "+"["+&Programa.ToString().Trim()+"] -> "
	&MensajeDebug = &MensajeDebug + &Log
	&ResultFile = DFWOpen(&NombreArchivo,"","",1)
	&ResultFile = DFWPTxt(&MensajeDebug)
	&ResultFile = DFWNext()
	&ResultFile = DFWClose()
endsub

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&NivelDebug,&Programa,&Log);

				// When inserting with instantiated InterrupcionId

			Endcase
		Endfor

=== Procedure: Produccion.CrearInterrupcion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	&Now = Now()
	&FechaRegistro = &Now.ToDate()

	//Guardar Interrupcion
    &Interrupcion = New()
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionHoraInicio = &Now
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionHoraFin = &Now
	&Interrupcion.InterrupcionMotivo = &Motivo
	&Interrupcion.DownTimeCodeId.SetNull()
	&Interrupcion.Save()

	if(&Interrupcion.Success())
		&InterrupcionId = &Interrupcion.InterrupcionId
		commit
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&Motivo, out:&InterrupcionId, out:&FechaRegistro);


=== Procedure: Produccion.GenerarBobinaNo ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	&BobinaNo = 0
	&InventarioItem = SDInventarioItem.Udp(&ProductoId)
	
	for each DB.Bobina
		where BobinaId > 0
		where BobinaProductoId = &ProductoId
		where ExtrusionId > 0
		where ExtrusionExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
		where BobinaHoraInicio > &InventarioItem.InventarioFechaHora
		where BobinaOrigen = OrigenBobina.A
		&BobinaNo += 1	
	endfor

=== Procedure: Produccion.GuardarBobina ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	&Id = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaId
	&ExtrusionId = &SDTBobinaItem.ExtrusionId
	&Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)

	if(&Id > 0)
		&Bobina.Load(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaId)
		&Bobina.BobinaMotivoMolino = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMotivoMolino
		&IsNew = false
	else
		&Bobina = New()
		&Bobina.BobinaMotivoMolino = MotivoMolino.NoAplica
		&Bobina.BobinaProductoId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionProductoId
		&Bobina.BobinaSiloVirgenId = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloVirgenId
	        &Bobina.BobinaLoteVirgen = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaLoteVirgen
	        &Bobina.BobinaSiloMolidoId = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaSiloMolidoId
		&Bobina.BobinaColorEstacion = ColorEstacion.SinAsignar
		&IsNew = true
	endif

	&Bobina.ExtrusionId = &SDTBobinaItem.ExtrusionId
	&Bobina.BobinaOrigen = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaOrigen
	&Bobina.BobinaHoraInicio = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraInicio
	&Bobina.BobinaHoraSalida = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaHoraSalida
	&Bobina.BobinaNo = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaNo
	&Bobina.BobinaKg = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaKg
	&Bobina.BobinaMermaKg = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMermaKg
	&Bobina.BobinaEspesor = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEspesor
	&Bobina.BobinaColorEstacion = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaColorEstacion
	&Bobina.BobinaDesviacionEstandar = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaDesviacionEstandar
	&Bobina.BobinaObservaciones = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaObservaciones
	&Bobina.BobinaEstado = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaEstado
	&Bobina.BobinaCarreras = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaCarreras
	&Bobina.BobinaIniciaReposo = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaIniciaReposo
	&Bobina.BobinaMinutosEnReposo = &SDTBobinaItem.BobinaMinutosEnReposo
	&Bobina.Save()

	if(&Bobina.Success())
		&BobinaId = &Bobina.BobinaId
		commit

		//Generar NoSerie de la Bobina
		if(&IsNew)
			BobinaNoSerie.Call(&BobinaId, &ExtrusionId)
		endif

		&Correcto = true
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&SDTBobinaItem,out:&Correcto);


=== Procedure: Produccion.ReasignarBobinaTurno ===

--- Source (Source) ---
        
        //Reasignar Bobinas sgte turno
	for &SDTBobinaItem in &SDTBobinaPendiente
		&Bobina.Load(&SDTBobinaItem.BobinaId)
		&Bobina.Mail.ExtrusionId = &NextExtId
		&Bobina.Save()
		commit
	endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&NextExtId, in:&SDTBobinaPendiente);


=== Procedure: Produccion.SgteTurnoExtrusora ===

--- Source (Source) ---
   
   &Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
   &ExtrusionFecha = &Extrusion.ExtrusionFecha
   &ExtrusoraId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId
   
   //Obtener el sgte turno para la Extrusora
   for each Order ExtrusionFecha
	   where ExtrusionId > 0
	   where ExtrusionFecha >= &ExtrusionFecha
	   where ExtrusionExtrusoraId = &ExtrusoraId
	   where ExtrusionEstado = EstadoExtrusion.Programada
	   &NextExtId = ExtrusionId
	   Exit
   when none
	   &NextExtId = 0	
   endfor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ExtrusionId, out:&NextExtId);

=== WebPanel: DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows

	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName

		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'

	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	ExtrusionInterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	ExtrusionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	InterrupcionId.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
					&TFExtrusionInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'ExtrusionId'
					&TFExtrusionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFExtrusionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionId'
					&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Update, ExtrusionInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ExtrusionInterrupcionId)
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'DB.ExtrusionInterrupcionWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.ExtrusionInterrupcion.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(ExtrusionInterrupcionId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionId'
					&TFInterrupcionId.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionId_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
					&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Set(&TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Year(), &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Month(), &TFInterrupcionHoraInicio_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
					&TFInterrupcionHoraFin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Set(&TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Year(), &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Month(), &TFInterrupcionHoraFin_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
					&TFInterrupcionTiempo.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFInterrupcionTiempo_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
					&TFInterrupcionConcluida_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
					&TFInterrupcionMotivo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFInterrupcionMotivo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeId'
					&TFDownTimeCodeId = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeId_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeDescription'
					&TFDownTimeCodeDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'DownTimeCodeType'
					&TFDownTimeCodeType = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFDownTimeCodeType_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase

=== Transaction: DB.Inventario ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by Work With Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	[web]
	{
	If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	&Insert_InventarioProductoId.SetEmpty()
	
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated InventarioProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InventarioProductoId"
					&Insert_InventarioProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	If (&TrnContext.TransactionName = &Pgmname and &Mode = TrnMode.Insert)
		For &TrnContextAtt in &TrnContext.Attributes
			Do Case
				// When inserting with instantiated InventarioProductoId
				Case &TrnContextAtt.AttributeName = !"InventarioProductoId"
					&Insert_InventarioProductoId.FromString(&TrnContextAtt.AttributeValue)
			Endcase
		Endfor
	Endif
	
    [web]
    {
	InventarioProductoId.Visible = False
	InventarioProductoNombre.Visible = False
	InventarioInicioConsecutivo.Visible = False
	InventarioCantidad.Visible = False
	}
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	If (&Mode = TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWInventario()
	Endif
	
	Return
	}
	/* Generated by Work With Pattern [End] - Do not change */

[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&InventarioId);

InventarioId = &InventarioId if not &InventarioId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InventarioId);
noprompt(InventarioId);

InventarioProductoId = &Insert_InventarioProductoId if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InventarioProductoId.IsEmpty();
noaccept(InventarioProductoId) if &Mode = TrnMode.Insert and not &Insert_InventarioProductoId.IsEmpty();
}

LoadAuditInventario.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, InventarioId, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;

=== Procedure: DB.LoadAuditExtrusionInterrupcion ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusionInterrupcion
		Where SAE.ExtrusionInterrupcionId = &ExtrusionInterrupcionId
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusionInterrupcion'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each ExtrusionInterrupcion
		Where ExtrusionInterrupcionId = &ExtrusionInterrupcionId
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'ExtrusionInterrupcion'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new SAE.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Extrusion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Interrupcion Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionInterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionInterrupcionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'ExtrusionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = ExtrusionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Interrupcion

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each Interrupcion
		Where InterrupcionId = &InterrupcionId
		If &ActualMode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new Common.AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'Interrupcion'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new Discussions.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Inicio'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraInicio.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Hora Fin'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraFin.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Tiempo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionTiempo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Concluida'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Motivo'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPBaseObjects.InterrupcionMotivo.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeId'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Id'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = Discussions.DownTimeCodeId.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeName'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Name'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeName.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeType'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Down Time Code Type'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeType.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraInicio'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraInicio.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionHoraFin'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionHoraFin.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionTiempo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionTiempo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionConcluida'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionConcluida.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'InterrupcionMotivo'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = InterrupcionMotivo.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeId'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeId.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeName'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DB.DownTimeCodeName.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'DownTimeCodeType'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = DownTimeCodeType.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== WebPanel: DB.ViewConfiguracion ===

--- Start (Event) ---
If not IsAuthorized(&PgmName)
		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	For each
		Where ConfiguracionKey = &ConfiguracionKey
		Form.Caption = ConfiguracionKey.ToString()
		ViewAll.Link = WWConfiguracion.Link()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "Record not found"
		ViewAll.Visible = false
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	If &Exists
		&SelectedTabCode = &TabCode
		Tab.ActivePageControlName = &SelectedTabCode
		Do 'Load Tab'
	Endif

--- Tab.TabChanged (Event) ---
&SelectedTabCode = Tab.ActivePageControlName
	&LoadAllTabs = false
	Do 'Load Tab'

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ConfiguracionKey, in:&TabCode);

		NotAuthorized(&PgmName)
	Endif
	Grid.Rows = 10
	&Update = "GXM_update"
	&Delete = "GX_BtnDelete"
	Form.Caption = 'Configuracions'

	Grid.LoadSessionState()

	&Delete.Link = Configuracion.Link(TrnMode.Delete, ConfiguracionKey)
	ConfiguracionKey.Link = ViewConfiguracion.Link(ConfiguracionKey, "")

=== Procedure: Produccion.BobinaNoSerie ===

--- Source (Source) ---
	
	&NoSerie.SetEmpty()
	&Extrusion.Load(&ExtrusionId)
	&ExtrusoraId = &Extrusion.ExtrusionExtrusoraId
	&Fecha = &Extrusion.ExtrusionFecha.ToDate()
	
	&Day = Day(&Fecha)
	&Month = Month(&Fecha)
	&Year = Year(&Fecha)
	&YearFormat = &Year.ToFormattedString()
	&YearFormat = &YearFormat.Substring(3,2)
	
	&NoSerie = 'B' + '-' + &Day.ToFormattedString() + &Month.ToFormattedString() + &YearFormat + '-' + &ExtrusoraId.ToFormattedString()
	
	//Debugger.Call(NivelDebug.Informativo,'AnioFormatted', &YearFormat)
	
	&Bobina.Load(&BobinaId)
	&BobinaConsecutivo = &Bobina.BobinaNo
	&Bobina.BobinaNoSerie = &NoSerie.Trim() + '-' + &BobinaConsecutivo.ToFormattedString() + &Bobina.BobinaOrigen.Trim()
	&Bobina.Save()
	
	if(&Bobina.Success())
	      //Debugger.Call(NivelDebug.Informativo,'Save' + &Bobina.BobinaNoSerie)
	      commit
	endif

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&BobinaId, in:&ExtrusionId);


=== Procedure: Produccion.SDInventarioItem ===

--- Source (Source) ---
 
		for each Order (InventarioFechaHora)
			where InventarioId > 0
			//where InventarioProductoId = &ProductoId
			&InventarioId = InventarioId
			Exit
		when none
			&InventarioFecha = Today()
			
			&Inventario = New()
			&Inventario.InventarioProductoId.SetNull()
			&Inventario.InventarioFechaHora = &InventarioFecha
			&Inventario.InventarioInicioConsecutivo =  #20-01-01 00:00#
			&Inventario.Save()
			
			if(&Inventario.Success())
				&InventarioId = &Inventario.InventarioId
				commit
			endif
			
		endfor
	
	    &Inventario.Load(&InventarioId)
		&InventarioItem.FromJson(&Inventario.ToJson())

--- Rules (Rules) ---
parm(in:&ProductoId,out:&InventarioItem);
